source.name: The Kitman – 'Puma Unveils Stunning New Zealand 2026 World Cup Kits'
source.quote: Puma has officially revealed the brand-new home and away kits for the New Zealand national football team.
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. 2026 shirts verified sponsor-free against the Puma launch photos (front, back, sleeves) and the 26 June 2026 World Cup match v Belgium.

summary: Nothing on the shirt but the fern: the All Whites' 2026 home kit carries no commercial sponsors, only the New Zealand Football crest and kit-maker Puma's logo.
